description: Fornecimento, the 16th system of the engineering model (PADRAO-DEV F7c, D-320): the third-party components, their suppliers and the advisories against them. Reader: scripts/lib/supply.py (scripts/supply).

supply.anthropic_monthly_usd.description: The monthly ceiling of the Anthropic account (SUP-anthropic) in US$: what Daniel pays Anthropic a month. VAL-anthropic-budget reads it as its threshold (threshold_key), so raising the budget is a change of this one value.

supply.blocking_severities.description: Advisory severities the supply check refuses while affecting (an update or an exemption with a reason and a deadline clears one); lower severities are measured, not refused.
